en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a street scene with a large historic building complex. On the left stands an ornate Neo-Gothic style structure with towers and pointed spires, attached to plainer multi‑storey buildings on the right. A dirt street and small outbuildings with a horse and cart are in the foreground. Around the image and at the bottom there is handwritten text in Hungarian. The caption under the photo identifies the view, and printed vertical text on the left margin gives the publisher. The back side has the heading 'Levelező-lap.' with Hungarian postage stamps and cancellation marks, plus an address written in cursive Hungarian script.
